source.figure_cropped_at: bottom edge (dress hem and standing foot are outside the frame)
source.quality_note: Heavily compressed 546x292 frame. Layer PNGs derived from it are for pose/z-order blocking review only, never for shipping.

canvas.retarget_note: Do not resample the blocking plates to 1024x1536. The figure is cut at the bottom, so a presenter canvas needs a repaint that extends the hem and the standing foot.

material_gates.comment: Thresholds measured from _probe/probe.json samples on reference-work.png (0-255).
material_gates.skin: luma > 118 and r >= g - 2 and r > b - 8
material_gates.hair: luma < 100 and b >= r - 2 and chroma < 62
material_gates.dress: r - g > 42 and r - b > 40 and g >= b - 8 and luma < 132
discriminators: Hair vs background wall/panel: both are cool (b>r). Only the traced envelope separates them.
Dress red (b <= g) vs elevator door red (b > g + 10). This is the one reliable colour split in the frame.
Skin is the only high-luma material; everything else sits under luma 132.

layers.name: hair_back
layers.pivot_meaning: crown / scalp centre, so head turn drags the whole mass
layers.deform: 3x5 warp, root row locked at the crown; two sway params (hair_back_x from head angle, hair_back_y from breath)
layers.notes: Includes both small horns and the left-pointing hair spikes at y~140 and y~230. Horns should later be promoted to their own rigid plate so they do not stretch with the sway warp.

layers.name: arm_hanging
layers.deform: two-bone rotation (upper arm, forearm); no warp needed at this size
layers.notes: STUB. Her right arm is occluded by the raised thigh from y~430 down; only the shoulder and a sliver of upper arm are visible. The plate is unusable as-is and must be inpainted (or repainted) before rigging, otherwise any arm rotation reveals a hole.

layers.name: standing_leg
layers.pivot_meaning: left hip joint, inferred under the dress (not a visible landmark)
layers.deform: single rotation at the hip plus a 2x3 warp for weight shift; knee is hidden by the hem so no knee joint is needed
layers.notes: Emerges from the dress slit at y~700 and runs off the bottom of the frame. The foot does not exist in the source. Needs a painted extension before it can carry weight in a rig.

layers.name: body
layers.pivot_meaning: hip centre; the whole rig's root
layers.deform: 3x4 warp for breath and torso lean; separate chest sub-warp for bounce
layers.notes: Exposed skin only: shoulders, neck base, cleavage, midriff. The cheongsam silk is a separate plate so the chest can bounce under the cloth. Split chest_l / chest_r out of this plate when the bounce rig goes in.

layers.name: dress
layers.pivot_meaning: waist, where the silk is pinned to the torso
layers.deform: 4x6 warp, top row locked at the waist, free at the hem; hem sway driven by the same phase as hair_back with a delay
layers.notes: One plate covering collar, bodice and the high-slit skirt. The skirt panel behind the raised leg should later be split into dress_front / dress_back_panel so the slit can open when the leg moves.

layers.name: raised_leg
layers.deform: three-bone chain (hip, knee at ~[650,600], ankle at ~[672,730]) plus a foot warp; the foot is strongly foreshortened so keep its mesh dense
layers.notes: The hero silhouette of the pose. Thigh runs from the hip leftward, knee at ~[650,600], ankle under the anklet at ~[672,730], sole and toes fill [518,850]-[730,1030]. Keep the foot as its own plate (raised_foot) once the mesh work starts; a single plate cannot flex at the ankle.

layers.name: arm_hip
layers.deform: two-bone rotation; elbow at ~[1340,480], wrist at ~[1180,555]
layers.notes: Akimbo: shoulder out to the elbow at ~[1340,480], forearm back in to the hand resting on the hip at ~[1100,540]. The triangular negative space between forearm and waist is the pose's read - do not let the dress plate bleed into it.

layers.name: head
layers.pivot_meaning: neck base, the head rotation centre
layers.deform: rigid rotate plus a light 3x3 warp for the tilt; face parts on top
layers.notes: Face plus neck. The eyes are half-lidded and the head is tilted ~12 deg to her right. Face parts (eye_l, eye_r, brow_l, brow_r, mouth) are NOT separable at this resolution - the whole eye is about 10 source pixels wide. They have to be repainted at target resolution.

layers.name: hair_front
layers.pivot_meaning: hairline centre, so bangs follow the head rigidly
layers.deform: rigid with the head plus a 3x3 tip warp for the long side strand
layers.notes: Bangs over the forehead (y 150-215) plus the long strand falling on the viewer's right down to y~330. Split that strand into hair_side_r when the mesh is built so it can swing independently of the bangs.

layers.name: accessory
layers.pivot_meaning: ankle, so the anklet rides the foot bone
layers.deform: rigid, parented to the ankle bone
layers.notes: Pale cord anklet with small beads, crossing the ankle at y~730. Extracted by local-luma threshold inside the envelope because it sits on skin and has no colour separation. About 25 source pixels wide - treat the plate as a position marker, not usable art.

known_gaps: arm_hanging is occluded below the shoulder; needs inpaint or repaint.
standing_leg has no foot in frame.
dress hem is cut off by the frame bottom.
Face parts (eyes, brows, mouth) are below the resolution needed to separate.
Background and figure share the same red/violet palette, so plate edges are approximate wherever a traced envelope borders the elevator door.
